relations.subject: Radha Krishna Choudhary
relations.evidence: In 1946, Choudhary joined Ganesh Dutt College, Begusarai as a lecturer of history.

relations.subject: Radha Krishna Choudhary
relations.evidence: He also served as vice-principal and acting principal at the college for 22 years.

relations.subject: Radha Krishna Choudhary
relations.evidence: After spending a year at the college, he established the Kashi Prasad Jaiswal Archaeological Museum aimed at preserving scattered archaeological remains of the Begusarai region.

relations.subject: Radha Krishna Choudhary
relations.evidence: Choudhary also served as the principal of Shankar Sah Vikramshila Mahavidyalaya in Kahalgaon for three years.

relations.subject: Radha Krishna Choudhary
relations.role: teaching in the Department of History
relations.evidence: In March 1974, he started teaching in the Department of History at Bhagalpur University, where he remained active until his retirement in 1984.
